name: Kamilia
source:
Kamilia is a story-driven, choices-matter detective mystery. Follow a talented painter who finds himself wrapped up in an unsolved case, as he tries to unveil a hidden truth that has been buried for years.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654030]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《卡米利亚》是一部故事驱动、选择至关重要的侦探悬疑小说。跟随一位才华横溢的画家，发现自己陷入了一个悬而未决的案件中，他试图揭开一个被埋藏多年的隐藏真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654030]Steam[/url]]
